# Mydeen Pitchai — Senior Full Stack Laravel & PHP Developer

> Mydeen Pitchai is a Senior Full Stack Developer from Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu, India with 7+ years of PHP, Laravel and WordPress experience. He builds web products that ship — e-commerce, healthcare, SaaS, sports and EdTech — and owns projects from brief to launch. RAMP Award winner (Touch Logic Technologies). Open for freelance projects.

Stack: Laravel, PHP, Phalcon, JavaScript, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, AWS S3, AWS Lambda, WordPress (incl. custom plugins and headless). AI-assisted development with Claude and ChatGPT — every line human-reviewed. Currently Senior Software Developer at OBII Kriationz Web LLP (since July 2024).
